definition.feedback: Hoan thien luong Web UI dang co cua Mini Task Manager: gom fetch vao request helper xu ly HTTP va network errors, hien thi thong bao loi de hieu (ke ca FastAPI validation detail arrays), aria-live/role=alert, loading/empty/retry states. Chan stale list responses khi doi search/filter nhanh; chi ap dung response moi nhat. Chan double submit va khoi phuc controls sau loi; giu filters/task data. Giu CRUD/status/search/SQLite API va UI hien co; khong them SaaS/dependencies. Viet focused automated checks bang code/terminal, khong browser/UAT. Neu dung Node tests thi dung private Node da co; pipeline QA phai chay cac checks nay. Preserve existing passing tests; doc exact app source, chi sua hanh vi con thieu.
definition.title: PM/BA requirements and engineering backlog

spec:
**Project Objective**

Develop a functional Mini Task Manager web application using an automated multi-agent software development workflow.

**Technology Stack**

*   Backend: Python FastAPI
    
*   Database: SQLite
    
*   Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
    
*   Testing: pytest
    
*   Version Control: Git and GitHub
    

**Functional Requirements**

1.  Create new tasks.
    
2.  View a list of tasks.
    
3.  Edit task information.
    
4.  Delete tasks.
    
5.  Update task status.
    
6.  Search and filter tasks.
    
7.  Persist data in SQLite.
    
8.  Provide a usable web interface.
    

**AI Development Workflow**

The AI team should:

1.  Analyze requirements and define acceptance criteria.
    
2.  Break down the project into development tasks.
    
3.  Establish dependencies and propose a development schedule.
    
4.  Implement source code in the Git repository.
    
5.  Build and execute automated tests.
    
6.  Review the implementation and identify defects.
    
7.  Fix defects and rerun tests.
    
8.  Create Git commits and a Pull Request.
    
9.  Report development progress and verification evidence in OpenProject.
    

**GitHub Repository**

[https://github.com/Luim3141/mini-task-manager](https://github.com/Luim3141/mini-task-manager)

**Completion Criteria**

The application must run locally, support the required operations, pass automated tests, and have verifiable source code and development history.

The AI agents must not automatically merge or deploy code without authorization.
